subject: [PATCH v2 4/4] selftests: cover readdir resuming at a removed entry

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test to the kernfs selftests suite called readdir_resume_at_removed_entry. The test covers the scenario where a directory listing is resumed at an entry that has been removed and then re-added. It takes a cookie for every entry, removes each one in turn, seeks to its cookie, and reads the rest of the entries without reporting any previously read entries as coming back. This ensures that readdir correctly resumes after an entry has been removed and re-added.
